newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telecasters buys Darwin TV licence.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telecasters buys Darwin TV licence.

text.p: Telecasters Australia Ltd said on Tuesday it had bought the second commercial television licence for Darwin in the Northern Territory for A$2.1 million.
The licence was the first free-to-air commercial television licence issued since 1986 and was bought earlier on Tuesday by auction.
"The purchase price is comfortably within the range of our planning to operate a second commercial service for Darwin," Telecasters Chairman Tim Downing said in a statement.
Telecasters' share price was up ten cents at A$6.40 at 2.45 pm (0345 GMT). -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
